summary: Mining is a gathering profession. Miners collect ore, stone and gems from mineral veins found across the world, and smelt ore into metal bars at a forge. Blacksmithing and Engineering use most of what miners gather.

ranks.basis: Max skill from the Forever spell tooltip.

tools.name: Mining Pick
tools.note: Must be in your bags to mine. Sold by trade supplies vendors.

abilities.name: Find Minerals
abilities.note: Shows nearby mineral veins on the minimap.

abilities.name: Smelting
abilities.note: Turns ore into bars. Needs a forge, or a Molten Foundry for Forever's top recipe.

nodes_contents_basis: The main ore and stone in each node are the Classic contents. The tooltip API does not list what a node contains, so these are not confirmed for Forever. Gem drops are not listed yet.

materials.note: Smelted into Heavy Thorium Bars (fan guides: at a Molten Foundry, Mining 300). Where it is mined is not confirmed.
materials.name: Heavy Thorium Ore

materials.note: Marked Scarce on Wowhead. Forever has three scarce materials per gathering profession, at item levels 25, 45 and 60; by name this is Mining's level 25 one, but where it is mined is not confirmed.
materials.name: Pyrite

materials.note: Marked Scarce on Wowhead. Forever has three scarce materials per gathering profession, at item levels 25, 45 and 60; by name this is Mining's level 45 one, but where it is mined is not confirmed.
materials.name: Bauxite

materials.note: Marked Scarce on Wowhead, Mining's item level 60 scarce material. Fan guides say it is smelted with Coal into Azerothium Bars (Mining 275). Where it is mined is not confirmed.
materials.name: Pitchblende

materials.note: Made by alchemists (Recipe: Transmute Legionite, Alchemy 275) from a Heavy Thorium Bar and a Fel Crystal. Used with Heavy Thorium Bars in Forever's level 60 Blacksmithing plans.
materials.name: Legionite Bar

recipes.name: Smelt Copper
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of copper ore into a copper bar. Smelting copper requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Tin
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of tin ore into a tin bar. Smelting tin requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Bronze
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a tin bar and a copper bar together into two bronze bars. Smelting bronze requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Silver
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of silver ore into a silver bar. Smelting silver requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Iron
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of iron ore into an iron bar. Smelting iron requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Gold
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of gold ore into a gold bar. Smelting gold requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Steel
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of iron ore and a lump of coal together into a steel bar. Smelting steel requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Mithril
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of mithril ore into a mithril bar. Smelting mithril requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Truesilver
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of truesilver ore into a truesilver bar. Smelting truesilver requires a forge.

recipes.name: Smelt Dark Iron
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt chunks of dark iron ore into a dark iron bar. Smelting Dark Iron can only be done at the Black Forge in Blackrock Depths.

recipes.name: Smelt Thorium
recipes.description: Allows the miner to smelt a chunk of thorium ore into a thorium bar. Smelting thorium requires a forge.

recipes_unresearched.name: Smelt Azerothium
recipes_unresearched.note: Fan guides say it uses Pitchblende and Coal at a forge. The items exist on Wowhead; the spell was not found on the tooltip API yet, so reagent counts are unknown.

recipes_unresearched.name: Smelt Heavy Thorium
recipes_unresearched.note: Fan guides say it needs Heavy Thorium Ore and a Molten Foundry. The items exist on Wowhead; the spell was not found on the tooltip API yet.

recipe_section.label: Smelting
recipe_section.intro: Smelting needs a forge unless noted. Skill levels are the Classic values; reagents and results are from the Forever tooltips.

materials_note: Gems come from mining nodes as a bonus. Which nodes drop which gems has not been researched yet.

camp.note: Lodestone is the Mining camp feature itself (not a blueprint). The Rock Garden and Molten Foundry can be placed over it.
camp.name: Lodestone
camp.effect: Erects a lodestone that allows you and others sitting nearby to gain

camp.name: Rock Garden
camp.effect: Places a Rock Garden that spawns a common mining node over time, and provides all the benefits of a Lodestone. Requires a Campfire nearby.

camp.name: Molten Foundry
camp.effect: Places a Molten Foundry usable for recipes that require it, and provides all the benefits of a Lodestone. Requires a Campfire nearby.

other_items.name: Enchant Gloves - Mining
other_items.note: +2 Mining. Wowhead marks it PTR only.

other_items.name: Enchant Gloves - Advanced Mining
other_items.note: +5 Mining. Wowhead marks it PTR only.

skill_up_rule: In Classic a node is orange (always gives a skill point) until 25 points above its requirement, yellow until 50 above, green until 100 above, then grey. Not confirmed for Forever.

conflicts: Smelt Azerothium (Mining 275) and Smelt Heavy Thorium (Mining 300) come from fan guides. Their items (Pitchblende 249426, Azerothium Bar 249726, Heavy Thorium Ore 248815, Heavy Thorium Bar 251291) are on Wowhead, but the smelting spells were not found, so the skill levels are unconfirmed.

One guide says Blizzard reduced the number of Poor Copper Vein nodes in starter areas on 1 October (beta). No Poor Copper Vein object was found in the tooltip scan, which did turn up two new starter-zone nodes, Chunk of Amber and Large Chunk of Amber.
gaps: The tooltip API maps only the zone with the most spawns of each node object. Other zones a node appears in are not listed. The full zone lists are on the Wowhead object pages, which could not be read from this environment.
Chunk of Amber and Large Chunk of Amber (new in Forever, Mining 1) have no known contents yet.
Node contents: ore and stone are the Classic contents and gem drops are not listed (see nodes_contents_basis).
Recipe skill levels are the Classic values (skill_basis: classic).
Trainers and their locations are not researched. Guides name Zephras Isle trainers, but spell them differently.
Rank training costs are not researched.
Where Heavy Thorium Ore and the scarce materials (Pyrite, Bauxite, Pitchblende) are gathered is not known. Fan guides say scarce materials come from normal nodes as a bonus.
